## Overview
This document provides metadata, variable dictionaries, and summary statistics for the datasets associated with the manuscript. These datasets are archived for reproducibility and public access.

## Data Description
These datasets contain empirical data collected to investigate the mechanisms linking pollinator visitation networks to stigmatic pollen deposition on *Succisa pratensis*. The study investigates how community-level network structure (specialization, interaction evenness) and single-visit pollen deposition stochastics scale to population-level pollination outcomes across three years (2022-2024).

The provided files are:
- `pollen_deposition.csv`: Total pollen loads on stigmas collected from the field.
- `SVD.csv`: Single-visit deposition experimental data.
- `network_metrics.csv`: Aggregated yearly metrics constructed from three primary data sources: 
  1. **Plant-pollinator visitation networks**: Used to calculate network-level specialization ($H_2'$) and species-level specialization/interaction evenness for *Succisa pratensis* using the `bipartite` R package.
  2. **Stigmatic pollen deposition**: Used to calculate the linear slope of Conspecific (CP) vs. Heterospecific (HP) pollen accumulation, and mean HP loads.
  3. **Floral abundance transects**: Used to calculate the mean *Succisa pratensis* abundance per plot and total community floral abundance.
- `interaction_data_all_22_24.csv`: Full plant-pollinator visitation observation data for the entire community across all years.
- `interaction_data_Succisa_22_24.csv`: Subset of the visitation data containing only observations for *Succisa pratensis*.
- `plant_abundance_22_24.csv`: Floral abundance transect data for all plots across years.
- `pollen_load_and_guts_2024_Succisa_pratensis.csv`: Raw pollen load and gut content data for individual pollinators.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(labelled)
```

```{r load-data}
# Load the exported datasets
data_dir <- "output/publication_data"
df_pollen <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "pollen_deposition.csv"))
df_svd <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "SVD.csv"))
df_network <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "network_metrics.csv"))

df_int_all <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "interaction_data_all_22_24.csv"))
df_int_succ <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "interaction_data_Succisa_22_24.csv"))
df_abund <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "plant_abundance_22_24.csv"))
df_pload <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "pollen_load_and_guts_2024_Succisa_pratensis.csv"))
```

---

## 1. Pollen Deposition Dataset (`pollen_deposition.csv`)
This dataset contains information regarding pollen deposition on individual stigmas of *Succisa pratensis* over three consecutive years.

### Data Dictionary
```{r dict-pollen}
var_label(df_pollen$id) <- "Unique sample identifier (Stigma ID)"
var_label(df_pollen$year) <- "Year of sampling (2022-2024)"
var_label(df_pollen$plant_id) <- "Unique plant/patch identifier"
var_label(df_pollen$conspecific_pollen) <- "Count of conspecific (Succisa) pollen grains on stigma"
var_label(df_pollen$heterospecific_pollen) <- "Count of heterospecific (non-Succisa) pollen grains on stigma"
var_label(df_pollen$pollen_total) <- "Total pollen count on stigma"

look_for(df_pollen, details = FALSE) %>%
  select(variable, label) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Variables in Pollen Deposition Dataset") %>%
  opt_stylize(style = 1, color = "blue")
```

### Summary Statistics
```{r summary-pollen}
df_pollen %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    N_Stigmas = n(),
    Unique_Plants = n_distinct(plant_id),
    Mean_CP = round(mean(conspecific_pollen, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    Mean_HP = round(mean(heterospecific_pollen, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
  ) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Pollen Deposition Sample Sizes & Means") %>%
  opt_stylize(style = 1, color = "blue")
```

---

## 2. Single Visit Deposition (SVD) Dataset (`SVD.csv`)
This dataset contains experimental observations of pollen deposition resulting from a single, uninterrupted visit by various pollinator morphogroups to virgin *Succisa pratensis* inflorescences.

### Data Dictionary
```{r dict-svd}
var_label(df_svd$id) <- "Unique sample identifier (Stigma ID)"
var_label(df_svd$year) <- "Year of observation"
var_label(df_svd$morphogroup) <- "Functional group of the visitor (e.g., Eristalis spp.)"
var_label(df_svd$species) <- "Taxonomic species of the pollinator"
var_label(df_svd$duration_sec) <- "Duration of the single visit (seconds)"
var_label(df_svd$conspecific_pollen) <- "Conspecific pollen deposited during single visit"
var_label(df_svd$heterospecific_pollen) <- "Heterospecific pollen deposited during single visit"

look_for(df_svd, details = FALSE) %>%
  select(variable, label) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Variables in SVD Dataset") %>%
  opt_stylize(style = 1, color = "green")
```

### Summary Statistics
```{r summary-svd}
df_svd %>%
  group_by(morphogroup) %>%
  summarise(
    N_Visits = n(),
    Mean_Duration_sec = round(mean(duration_sec, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    Mean_CP_Deposited = round(mean(conspecific_pollen, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    Mean_HP_Deposited = round(mean(heterospecific_pollen, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
  ) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Single Visit Deposition (SVD) Sample Sizes") %>%
  opt_stylize(style = 1, color = "green")
```

---

## 3. Network Metrics Dataset (`network_metrics.csv`)
This dataset aggregates plot-level and community-level metrics calculated from plant-pollinator interaction networks, floral abundance surveys, and overall stigmatic pollen loads.

### Data Dictionary
```{r dict-network}
var_label(df_network$Year) <- "Year of sampling"
var_label(df_network$H2) <- "Network Specialization index (H2')"
var_label(df_network$Succisa_H) <- "Interaction Evenness (Shannon's H)"
var_label(df_network$Succisa_d) <- "Interaction Specialization (d')"
var_label(df_network$Slope) <- "Slope (Beta) of the CP-HP relationship (Type 1 dynamics)"
var_label(df_network$Mean_HP) <- "Mean Heterospecific Pollen per stigma"
var_label(df_network$Succisa_Abundance) <- "Mean abundance of Succisa pratensis per plot"
var_label(df_network$Total_Abundance) <- "Total floral abundance in the community"

look_for(df_network, details = FALSE) %>%
  select(variable, label) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Variables in Network Metrics Dataset") %>%
  opt_stylize(style = 1, color = "gray")
```

### Summary Statistics
```{r summary-network}
df_network %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(
    Plots = n(),
    Mean_H2 = round(mean(H2, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    Mean_Evenness = round(mean(Succisa_H, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    Mean_Total_Abundance = round(mean(Total_Abundance, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
  ) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Network Metrics Summary per Year") %>%
  opt_stylize(style = 1, color = "gray")
```

---

## 4. Full Interaction Dataset (`interaction_data_all_22_24.csv`)
This dataset contains the complete plant-pollinator visitation observation data for the entire community across all years (2022-2024).

### Data Dictionary
```{r dict-int-all}
var_label(df_int_all$sampling_id) <- "Unique sampling event ID"
var_label(df_int_all$year) <- "Year of observation"
var_label(df_int_all$plot_id) <- "Plot identifier"
var_label(df_int_all$plant_name) <- "Visited plant species"
var_label(df_int_all$network_species) <- "Harmonized pollinator species name"
var_label(df_int_all$order) <- "Pollinator taxonomic order"
var_label(df_int_all$n_visits) <- "Number of observed visits"
var_label(df_int_all$rate) <- "Visitation rate"

look_for(df_int_all, details = FALSE) %>%
  filter(variable %in% c("sampling_id", "year", "plot_id", "plant_name", "network_species", "order", "n_visits", "rate")) %>%
  select(variable, label) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Selected Variables in Full Interaction Dataset") %>%
  opt_stylize(style = 1, color = "pink")
```

### Summary Statistics
```{r summary-int-all}
df_int_all %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Visits = sum(n_visits, na.rm = TRUE),
    Unique_Pollinator_Species = n_distinct(network_species),
    Unique_Plant_Species = n_distinct(plant_name)
  ) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Community Visitation Summary") %>%
  opt_stylize(style = 1, color = "pink")
```

---

## 5. Succisa Interaction Dataset (`interaction_data_Succisa_22_24.csv`)
This dataset is a subset of the full interaction dataset, focusing specifically on pollinator visitations to *Succisa pratensis*.

### Data Dictionary
```{r dict-int-succ}
var_label(df_int_succ$sampling_id) <- "Unique sampling event ID"
var_label(df_int_succ$year) <- "Year of observation"
var_label(df_int_succ$plot_id) <- "Plot identifier"
var_label(df_int_succ$plant_name) <- "Visited plant species (Succisa pratensis)"
var_label(df_int_succ$network_species) <- "Harmonized pollinator species name"
var_label(df_int_succ$n_visits) <- "Number of observed visits"

look_for(df_int_succ, details = FALSE) %>%
  filter(variable %in% c("sampling_id", "year", "plot_id", "plant_name", "network_species", "n_visits")) %>%
  select(variable, label) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Selected Variables in Succisa Interaction Dataset") %>%
  opt_stylize(style = 1, color = "red")
```

### Summary Statistics
```{r summary-int-succ}
df_int_succ %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Succisa_Visits = sum(n_visits, na.rm = TRUE),
    Unique_Pollinators = n_distinct(network_species)
  ) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Succisa pratensis Visitation Summary") %>%
  opt_stylize(style = 1, color = "red")
```

---

## 6. Plant Abundance Dataset (`plant_abundance_22_24.csv`)
This dataset contains floral abundance counts for all plant species across the study plots over three years.

### Data Dictionary
```{r dict-abund}
var_label(df_abund$year) <- "Year of sampling"
var_label(df_abund$plot_id) <- "Plot identifier"
var_label(df_abund$Suc_pra) <- "Abundance of Succisa pratensis (inflorescences)"

look_for(df_abund, details = FALSE) %>%
  filter(variable %in% c("year", "plot_id", "Suc_pra")) %>%
  select(variable, label) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Key Variables in Plant Abundance Dataset") %>%
  opt_stylize(style = 1, color = "cyan")
```

### Summary Statistics
```{r summary-abund}
df_abund %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    N_Plots = n_distinct(plot_id),
    Mean_Succisa_Abundance = round(mean(Suc_pra, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    Max_Succisa_Abundance = max(Suc_pra, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Succisa pratensis Abundance Summary") %>%
  opt_stylize(style = 1, color = "cyan")
```

---

## 7. Pollinator Pollen Load Dataset (`pollen_load_and_guts_2024_Succisa_pratensis.csv`)
This dataset contains raw pollen loads carried on the bodies and within the guts of individual pollinators captured on *Succisa pratensis* in 2024.

### Data Dictionary
```{r dict-pload}
var_label(df_pload$id) <- "Unique pollinator specimen ID"
var_label(df_pload$pollinator_species) <- "Pollinator species name"
var_label(df_pload$suc_pra_load) <- "Count of Succisa pratensis pollen on body"
var_label(df_pload$other_pollen_load) <- "Count of heterospecific pollen on body"
var_label(df_pload$suc_pra_guts) <- "Count of Succisa pratensis pollen in gut"

look_for(df_pload, details = FALSE) %>%
  filter(variable %in% c("id", "pollinator_species", "suc_pra_load", "other_pollen_load", "suc_pra_guts")) %>%
  select(variable, label) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Key Variables in Pollen Load Dataset") %>%
  opt_stylize(style = 1, color = "blue")
```

### Summary Statistics
```{r summary-pload}
df_pload %>%
  group_by(pollinator_species) %>%
  summarise(
    N_Specimens = n(),
    Mean_Body_CP = round(mean(suc_pra_load, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    Mean_Body_HP = round(mean(other_pollen_load, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(N_Specimens)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Top 5 Pollinators by Sample Size (2024 Body Loads)") %>%
  opt_stylize(style = 1, color = "blue")
```
